finding: Matched 24-angle turntables show that the inherited HD GLB already has convincing whole-body silhouette, horn roots, eye sockets, cheek/neck integration and texture variation. The separately generated parametric head loses these qualities despite proving some jaw motion.
guidance: Keep the inherited HD cranium, horns, eyes, neck, wings, body, tail and visual palette as the production appearance baseline. Use the parametric head only for rig/anatomy experiments. Retopologize the mouth region locally and rebuild a volumetric hinge on the HD surface, then transfer/bake its appearance and re-run full-action and matched-camera tests. Do not replace the complete head or creature with the graybox loft.
